clips.text: 我去开会汇报抽样调查落实的情况

limitations: Actual pinned Three.js GLTFLoader 0.170.0 plus pinned production rig/retarget/stage CPU execution; textures and renderer are stubbed. Not browser/WebGL, screenshots, mobile performance or deployed vendor equality.

Full original motion archive, real MotionRegistry, presentation CLI, server and deployment were not run. Six source wrappers match the original manifest; declared registry hashes match old and current presets.
No source-video, human motion-quality, sign-language semantic or automatic semantic mouth acceptance.
Retarget maps 40 upper-body bones, not lower-body source motion. Keeping v13 defaults is not testing arbitrary hip/knee animation.
All vertices checked only at listed selected poses; finite bone transforms at all integer and listed fractional samples. No full collision guarantee.
Historical v11/v12 whole-skeleton zero-difference evidence is not reused.
